messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a close-up shot of the person's face from the front. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the video's camera setup to a close-up shot of the person's face from the front. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The woman faces the camera and blinks, with subtle head movements and slight changes in her facial expression.","camera":"A medium close-up shot that slowly zooms in on the woman's face, keeping her centered in the frame.","clothing":"A bright pink, off-the-shoulder top with a sweetheart neckline.","hair_color":"Blonde with darker brown roots and highlights.","hairstyle":"Blonde hair with straight bangs, styled into two high buns on either side of the head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered woman with dark skin, brown eyes, and a neutral-to-slightly-smiling expression.","scene":"A futuristic, sci-fi environment at night, featuring a large glass dome structure with glowing pink and teal lights in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output replaces the source's side full-body walking shot with a front-facing medium close-up of the woman's face and upper chest. She is centered, facing the camera, with the same futuristic dome scene behind her. The camera slowly moves closer, and her visible action changes from walking to subtle head movement, blinking, and slight facial expression changes.
arguments.requested_change: Change only the camera setup to a front close-up of the person's face, using the reference for initial direction, placement, and framing while preserving appearance, expression, action, scene, timing, and progression.
uncertain: Whether the subtle facial expression changes are intended preservation of the source expression or newly generated expression.
Whether the slow camera movement matches the intended camera movement beyond the initial reference framing.
unexpected_changes: The source walking action was not preserved; the output shows the subject mostly stationary with only subtle head and facial movement.
The framing is a medium close-up including shoulders and upper chest rather than a tight face-only close-up.
The outfit appears as an off-the-shoulder top in the output, whereas the source showed a fitted long-sleeve top and white skirt; the skirt is not visible in the new framing.
